title: IntelliAskCorpusManifest
description: Corpus manifest for IntelliAsk pothole depth estimation scientific evaluation papers.
notes: Curated scientific evaluation corpus comprising 7 verified research papers in data/papers/.

papers.title: Smartphone-based accurate pothole depth estimation using monocular RGB and LiDAR-guided deep learning
papers.notes: Published May 8, 2026 in PLOS ONE 21(5): e0344604. Open-access Creative Commons CC BY 4.0. Dataset on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.15773442). Monocular RGB depth prediction (MiDaS DPT) with iPhone 14 Pro integrated LiDAR ground-truth guidance.

papers.title: Robust Video-Based Pothole Detection and Area Estimation for Intelligent Vehicles with Depth Map and Kalman Smoothing
papers.notes: arXiv preprint [cs.CV] submitted May 27, 2025. Proposes ACSH-YOLOv8 + DepthAnything V2 + MBTP (Minimum Bounding Triangulated Pixel) area estimation with CDKF Kalman filtering on Clear Road and Dark Road datasets.

papers.title: High-Precision 3D Recognition of Road Potholes Based on Binocular Vision and Cross-Modal Feature Fusion
papers.notes: Published in The International Archives of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences, Volume XLVIII-4/W14-2025, pp. 291-296. Peer-reviewed open access CC BY 4.0. ZED 2i binocular camera + Mask R-CNN + dynamic mesh density.

papers.title: 3D vision and depth sensing for intelligent pothole detection using time-of-flight imaging
papers.notes: Published in Measurement: Sensors 45 (2026) 102002 (available online April 18, 2026). Elsevier open access CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Evaluates Basler Time-of-Flight Camera (Sony DepthSense, 940 nm) on 5 geometric pothole morphologies.

papers.title: Rethinking Road Surface 3D Reconstruction and Pothole Detection: From Perspective Transformation to Disparity Map Segmentation
papers.notes: arXiv:2012.10802v2 [cs.CV] preprint submitted Dec 31, 2020. Journal version published in IEEE Transactions on Cybernetics, Vol. 52, No. 7, pp. 5799-5808, July 2022 (DOI: 10.1109/TCYB.2021.3060461). SGM disparity transformation with roll angle formulation and SLIC superpixel segmentation.

papers.title: Deep Learning Enhanced Feature Extraction of Potholes Using Vision and LiDAR Data for Road Maintenance
papers.notes: Published in IEEE Access, Vol. 12, pp. 184541-184549, Dec 2024. IEEE open access CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Integrates Ouster OS1-32 LiDAR with RGB camera and YOLOv5-v8 models, producing interactive HTML pothole severity maps.

papers.title: Robust Pothole Detection through dual-pass RGB and Depth Fusion
papers.notes: Attributed to BMVC 2025 Workshop based on download source from BMVA archive; PDF carries author copyright notice but no embedded DOI or publisher pagination. Proposes dual-pass YOLOv11x-seg and DINOv2 fusion on West Road and Tennis Court Road datasets.
